fold_rule: stratify 100 positive and 100 negative train source examples; seeded shared fold assignment for all source models
feature_contract: post-block final-token BF16 activation saved float32, centered with each model's 300-anchor mu, point projection Ahat@unit(h-mu), direction Ahat@unit(mean(training pos)-mean(training neg))
fold_validation: train-only positive/negative class midpoint threshold; exclude held-out fold from direction and cutoff
error_definition: 0/1 classification errors for source model self-classification OOF, 200 paired rows per behavior axis; no target train/dev labels in weights

correlated_error.estimator: weights_from_source_errors; quadratic E[e_i e_j] on shared OOF questions

source_oof_best_single.rule: higher source OOF balanced accuracy; ties use participant order

target_oracle_best_single.rule: pick source based on target dev AUROC; report only post-hoc, not deployable

direction_combine: canonical_mean_raw([c_source1,c_source2],weights) then unit for detection only; no independent rescaling of each projected source axis before weighting
evaluation: target-model dev point projected using same 300 anchors; label used only to score AUROC; labels never used to choose weights, sign, folds or hyperparameters
uncertainty: 999 paired stratified bootstrap of target 50 positive/50 negative examples, common sampled indices for all compared weights
endpoints: LOO per-target per-axis report no aggregation hides failures
caveats: This uses the same already-seen development split from B; not a blind preregistration or independent hypothesis test
Target-native train upper bound and target-dev oracle are not deployable selection rules
Source OOF classification is a surrogate of transferred-axis reliability, not a proof of target reliability
Mistral7B replaces initially gated Llama3.2-3B, a model-composition deviation
Do not use target dev results to revise the weight estimator after this run
